$comment: Parametric builder definitions. A builder is a reusable generator implemented once in each host: AutoCAD draws its 2D representation (block symbol for point builders, polyline/hatch for path and polygon builders) and SketchUp reconstructs its 3D geometry. Element types (element-types.json) reference a builder and override defaults. All lengths are metres, angles are degrees. Parameter 'type' is one of: length, number, integer, angle, bool, enum, text, material.

slab.description: Ploča površine ograničena zatvorenom granicom; vrh na koti granice + pomak, debljina prema dolje.
slab.descriptionEn: Surface slab bounded by a closed boundary, top at boundary elevation + topOffset, extruded downward by thickness.

massing.description: Volumen objekta ili reference istisnut iz tlocrta.
massing.descriptionEn: Building or reference massing extruded from a footprint.

linear_slab.description: Traka konstantne širine duž osovine (saobraćajnice, staze, oznake, kanali).
linear_slab.descriptionEn: Strip of constant width along a centreline (roads, paths, markings, trenches).

wall.description: Zid, ivičnjak, živa ograda ili rubnjak duž trase, s mogućim trakastim temeljem.
wall.descriptionEn: Wall, kerb, hedge or edging following an alignment, with optional strip footing.

fence.description: Stubovi na jednakom razmaku duž trase (prave i krive), s panelima između stubova.
fence.descriptionEn: Posts at regular spacing along an alignment (straight and curved), with panels between posts.

channel.description: Linijski drenažni kanal; tjemena trase određuju kotu rešetke.
channel.descriptionEn: Linear drainage channel; path vertices define the grate (top) level.

pipe.description: Cijev, kabl ili trasa duž putanje; osovina vertikalno pomaknuta od putanje (negativno = ukopano).

parameters.label: Visinski pomak osovine od kote trase

pipe.descriptionEn: Pipe, duct, cable or route along a path; axis offset vertically from the path (negative = buried).

tree.description: Drvo s deblom i krošnjom. Botaničke podatke unosi korisnik; zadane vrijednosti su generičke.
tree.descriptionEn: Tree with trunk and canopy. Botanical data must be supplied by the user; defaults are generic placeholders.

pole_mounted.description: Stub s krakom i glavom (svjetiljka, kamera, zvučnik, antena). Krak je usmjeren duž lokalne +X ose.
pole_mounted.descriptionEn: Pole with an arm and a head unit (luminaire, camera, speaker, antenna). The arm points along local +X.

bench.description: Klupa, stolica ili ležaljka. Dužina duž lokalne X ose; prednja strana sjedišta prema lokalnoj -Y.
bench.descriptionEn: Bench, chair or lounger. Length along local X; the seat front faces local -Y.

table.description: Stol s mogućim pripojenim klupama na dužim stranama. Dužina duž lokalne X ose.
table.descriptionEn: Table with optional attached benches on both long sides. Length along local X.

bike_stand.description: Niz lukova za bicikle. Svaki luk je paralelan lokalnoj X osi; lukovi se ponavljaju duž lokalne +Y.
bike_stand.descriptionEn: Row of bicycle hoops. Each hoop is parallel to local X; hoops repeat along local +Y at the given spacing.

box_equipment.description: Opća pravougaona oprema ili mobilijar centriran na tački umetanja. Pomak baze: pozitivno za zidnu montažu, negativno za ukopano.
box_equipment.descriptionEn: Generic rectangular equipment or furniture body, centred on the insertion point. Use baseOffset for wall-mounted (positive) or buried (negative) items.

cylinder_equipment.description: Opće cilindrično tijelo (kante, stubići, posude, rezervoari, male svjetiljke).
cylinder_equipment.descriptionEn: Generic cylindrical body (bins, posts, pots, tanks, small lights).

underground_container.description: Podzemni ili polupodzemni kontejner: ukopano tijelo, platforma na koti poklopca, stub za ubacivanje iznad tla. Zadane dimenzije su orijentacione i moraju se zamijeniti podacima proizvođača.

parameters.label: Visina iznad tla (stub ili gornji dio)
Pomak kote poklopca od kote umetanja
parameters.labelEn: Cover level offset from insertion elevation

underground_container.descriptionEn: Underground or semi-underground waste container: buried body, top platform at cover level, insertion column above ground. Default dimensions are indicative only and must be replaced by manufacturer data.

chamber.description: Reviziono, ventilsko ili vodomjerno okno, šaht. Kota umetanja = završni teren; primjenjuje se pomak kote poklopca.
chamber.descriptionEn: Inspection chamber, manhole, valve or meter chamber. Insertion elevation = finished ground; cover level offset applies.

tank.description: Rezervoar ili cisterna (kvadar, horizontalni ili vertikalni cilindar), podzemno s nadslojem ili nadzemno.

parameters.label: Nadsloj (od terena do vrha rezervoara)
parameters.labelEn: Cover depth (ground to top of tank)

tank.descriptionEn: Tank or cistern (box, horizontal or vertical cylinder), underground with cover depth or above ground.

pergola.description: Pergola, nadstrešnica za automobile ili nadstrešnica na orijentisanom pravougaoniku tlocrta: stubovi, obodne grede, rožnjače ili lamele i pokrov.
pergola.descriptionEn: Pergola, carport or canopy on the oriented bounding rectangle of the footprint (first edge defines orientation): columns, perimeter beams, rafters or louvers and an optional cover.

shelter.description: Nadstrešnica, sjenica ili paviljon centriran na tački umetanja; otvorena strana prema lokalnoj -Y.
shelter.descriptionEn: Shelter, gazebo or pavilion centred on the insertion point; open side faces local -Y.

parking_bay.description: Parking ili utovarno mjesto. Tačka umetanja = sredina ivice prema prolazu; mjesto se pruža duž lokalne +Y.
parking_bay.descriptionEn: Parking or loading bay. Insertion point = centre of the access (aisle) edge; the bay extends along local +Y.

stripes.description: Površina s prugama (pješački prelazi, šrafirane površine). Pruge su paralelne prvoj ivici granice.
stripes.descriptionEn: Striped marking area (pedestrian crossings, hatched areas). Stripes run parallel to the first boundary edge and repeat across the area, clipped to the boundary's oriented bounding rectangle.

arrow_marking.description: Iscrtana strelica smjera duž lokalne +X ose, od tačke umetanja.
arrow_marking.descriptionEn: Painted direction arrow pointing along local +X, starting at the insertion point.

sign_post.description: Znak, informativna tabla ili panel na jednom ili dva stupca. Lice je čitljivo s lokalne -Y strane.
sign_post.descriptionEn: Sign, information board or panel on one or two posts. The face is readable from local -Y.

gate.description: Kapija ili rampa. Tačka umetanja = sredina otvora; otvor duž lokalne X ose.
gate.descriptionEn: Gate or barrier. Insertion point = centre of the opening; the opening runs along local X; swing leaves open toward the chosen side.

pool.description: Korito sa zidovima, dnom i vodenom površinom. Granica je unutrašnja ivica na koti ruba.
pool.descriptionEn: Basin with walls, floor and water surface. The boundary is the inner (water-side) edge at coping level.

planter.description: Podignuta žardinjera: obodni zid duž vanjske granice, zemlja i zasad.
planter.descriptionEn: Raised planter: perimeter wall following the outer boundary, soil fill and optional planting mass.

planting_area.description: Gredica, travnjak ili livada: sloj zemlje i pojednostavljen zasad. Količina biljaka procjenjuje se iz razmaka.
planting_area.descriptionEn: Planting bed, lawn or meadow: soil layer plus a simplified planting mass. Plant quantity can be estimated from spacing.

basin.description: Udubljenje s kosim stranicama (retencijski bazen, kišni vrt, bio-kanal). Granica je gornja ivica.
basin.descriptionEn: Depression with sloped sides (retention/detention basin, rain garden, bioswale). The boundary is the top edge.

zone.description: Prozirni volumen zone (zona opreme, održavanja, komfora, reciklažnog ostrva).
zone.descriptionEn: Translucent zone volume (equipment zone, maintenance area, comfort zone, recycling island footprint).

circle_zone.description: Kružna zona (zaštita korijena, sigurnosna zona, ilustrativni domet).
circle_zone.descriptionEn: Circular zone (root protection, safety envelope, illustrative coverage).

steps.description: Stepenište na orijentisanom pravougaoniku granice; penje se od prve ivice granice.
steps.descriptionEn: Flight of steps on the oriented bounding rectangle of the boundary. The flight ascends away from the first boundary edge.

ramp.description: Rampa na orijentisanom pravougaoniku granice; uzdiže se od prve ivice granice.
ramp.descriptionEn: Ramp on the oriented bounding rectangle of the boundary, rising away from the first boundary edge.

swing.description: Okvir ljuljačke sa sjedištima. Greda duž lokalne X ose.
swing.descriptionEn: Swing frame with seats. Beam along local X.

cable_line.description: Sajla između stubova na prvom i posljednjem tjemenu trase (zip-line).
cable_line.descriptionEn: Cable between posts at the first and last path vertex (zip line).

solar_array.description: Fotonaponski niz na tlu. Moduli se ponavljaju duž lokalne +X, redovi duž +Y; moduli okrenuti prema -Y.
solar_array.descriptionEn: Ground-mounted PV array. Modules repeat along local +X; rows repeat along local +Y; modules face local -Y and tilt upward toward +Y.

vawt.description: Vjetroturbina s vertikalnom osom: stub i cilindrični gabarit rotora.
vawt.descriptionEn: Vertical-axis wind turbine: mast and cylindrical rotor envelope.

sail.description: Jedro za sjenu kroz 3 ili 4 ugaone tačke s naizmjenično visokim i niskim kotama i stubovima u uglovima.
sail.descriptionEn: Shade sail through 3 or 4 corner points with alternating high and low fixing heights and masts at the corners.

outline.description: Referentna kontura (parcelna granica, postojeći element). Izvozi se kao ivice bez površina.
outline.descriptionEn: Reference outline (site boundary, existing feature). Exported as edges without faces.

marker.description: Referentna oznaka (ulaz u objekat, pristupna tačka) usmjerena duž lokalne +X ose.
marker.descriptionEn: Reference marker (building entrance, access point) pointing along local +X.

fountain.description: Okruglo korito fontane s vodenim mlazom.
fountain.descriptionEn: Round fountain basin with a water jet.

boulder.description: Dekorativni kamen aproksimiran fasetiranim elipsoidom, djelimično ukopan.
boulder.descriptionEn: Decorative stone or boulder approximated by a faceted ellipsoid, partly embedded.
